copy.ourSoftwareStackIsOrganized: Our software stack is organized using an industry-standard Subsea Control Hierarchy, isolating low-level hardware actuation from high-level strategic reasoning. This guarantees that individual node failures never compromise vehicle stability.
copy.executiveMissionLogicQualificationTask: Executive mission logic, qualification task sequencing, and fallback behavior trees.
copy.yolov8TargetDetectionOpencvColor: YOLOv8 target detection, OpenCV color gating, buoy identification, and bin segmentation.
copy.stateEstimationExtendedKalmanFilter: State estimation, Extended Kalman Filter (EKF), IMU fusion, and waypoint trajectory planning.
copy.pidPositionVelocityLoopsAnd: PID position/velocity loops and 8-thruster holonomic allocation matrix.
copy.stm32MicrocontrollerDriversSerialMicro: STM32 microcontroller drivers, serial micro-ROS communication, and PWM generators.
copy.trainedOnHundredsOfSynthetic: Trained on hundreds of synthetic and in-pool annotated images, our deep neural networks accurately recognize underwater gates, torpedo targets, style markers, and bins despite water turbidity and shifting caustic sunlight.
copy.ourAutomatedPlanningSystemRelies: Our automated planning system relies on reactive Behavior Trees. If a target is lost or obstructed by bubbles, the vehicle gracefully pivots into a localized search pattern before timing out and moving to the next objective.
copy.toLocateTheUnderwaterAcoustic: To locate the underwater acoustic pinger, Ogopogo samples signals from an array of 4 subsea hydrophones. Phase differences are processed using cross-correlation algorithms to compute precise 3D azimuth and elevation bearings.
copy.weReplicateCompetitionOceanDynamics: We replicate competition ocean dynamics in Stonefish, simulating hydrodynamic drag, thruster fluid dynamics, synthetic camera distortion, and buoyancy imbalances to validate full mission logic before touching pool water.
copy.stonefishSubseaSimulatorAlongsideTheAlt: Stonefish Subsea Simulator alongside the ROS visualization window
